profile_text.body:
Perplexity, founded in 2022 and based in San Francisco, describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question. The company operates two main products: Perplexity AI, a search-augmented LLM available at perplexity.ai, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, which offers enterprise search capabilities including internal knowledge search, data indexing, single sign-on, and audit logs. Perplexity also maintains MCP servers that enable real-time web search, reasoning, and research through its API.

The company faces significant litigation. Cases have been filed against Perplexity across multiple federal districts, including The New York Times Company, Cable News Network Inc, Chicago Tribune Company LLC, Encyclopaedia Britannica Inc, and Amazon.com Services LLC. An Amazon case has reached the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Additional cases include Gagleard v. Perplexity AI in both the Northern and Eastern Districts of California, and Noel v. Perplexity AI in the Northern District of California. California accounts for 220 cases in the law exposure data held for the company.
